caption: Baia del Silenzio, Sestri Levante
composition: Horseshoe Bay of Silence lined with pastel Ligurian houses · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks down on the horseshoe curve of the Baia del Silenzio at midday from the headland. The pastel Ligurian houses climb the green slope at the right, the sandy beach with its bathers curving away to the center, and the stone breakwater reaching into the blue water at the left. The modelled 23 September 2026, 12:15 sun is bright and high, the clear water shading from turquoise at the shore to deep blue offshore.
